page.overview:
What is Bajazet Al-Nasir?

Lord Bajazet al-Nasir (also spelled Bajazet al-Nazir) was a sixth generation Assamite and a part of the Conspiracy of Isaac.

A dark-skinned man with angular, chiseled features, he speaks softly yet quite animatedly when in conversation with others. His movements are always quick and silent. He enjoys dancing with death, and respects only those who can face death with cleverness and panache.

Even though it is not stated which caste he belongs to, judging by his Disciplines he probably belongs to the Warrior Caste of the Assamite clan.
